instruction: Please enable format on save in VS Code editor settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling format on save in VS Code editor. Evaluator reads settings.json and verifies the 'editor.formatOnSave' setting is set to true.
metadata.verification: Verified that getter reads settings.json from VM and metric checks if editor.formatOnSave equals true. Added postconfig to close VS Code to ensure settings are saved.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly targets VS Code settings file at /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric correctly checks editor.formatOnSave setting against expected value (true)
Postconfig appropriately kills VS Code to ensure settings are persisted to disk before verification
Complete coverage: single requirement (enable format on save) is fully verified
Correct parameter handling: metric function correctly accesses rules.get('expected_value') without incorrect patterns
Robust edge case handling: handles missing file, JSON parse errors, and missing setting key
Practical feasibility: getter can access VM filesystem, postconfig ensures state persistence
